ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, points A, B, and C are all on the circle $ \odot O$. When $ \angle OAC=50^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $ \angle B$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that points A, B, and C are all on the circle $\odot O$, $\angle OAC=50^\circ$,\\
it follows that $OA=OC$,\\
thus $\angle OAC=\angle OCA=50^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle AOC=180^\circ-2\times 50^\circ=80^\circ$,\\
since $\overset{\frown}{AC}=\overset{\frown}{AC}$,\\
it implies that $\angle B=\frac{1}{2}\angle AOC=\frac{1}{2}\times 80^\circ=\boxed{40^\circ}$;
